messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Bioconductor support
parts:
the shinyapps package should be inspecting what you have installed in your own machine and sending that along to our service.  Assuming your environment is picking out the right package (and we don't have any bugs in that logic) we should be picking out exactly the same version as you.  
That being said the odds of us getting it 100% correct on the first try is probably too much to hope for :)
